title: Everyday Activities in the Present Tense
definition: Use the present tense (Präsens) to describe daily routines, habits, and actions happening now. Many daily-routine verbs are regular, while separable verbs such as aufstehen split in main clauses.

rules.title: Talk about your morning
rules.explanation: Use the present tense and time expressions to describe the order of your day.

examples.german: Ich stehe um sieben Uhr auf.
examples.english: I get up at seven o'clock.
Then I go to the university.

rules.title: Talk about work and study
rules.explanation: Use everyday verbs for work, study, and travel.

examples.german: Am Abend mache ich meine Hausaufgaben.
examples.english: In the evening I do my homework.

rules.title: Talk about meals and free time
rules.explanation: Use common verbs for eating, relaxing, and hobbies.

examples.english: At the weekend I play football.

rules.title: Connect routine steps
rules.explanation: Use dann, danach, später, zuerst, and zum Schluss to organize a routine.

examples.german: Zuerst frühstücke ich. Danach gehe ich zur Arbeit.
examples.english: First I have breakfast. After that I go to work.

examples.german: Zum Schluss gehe ich ins Bett.

common_mistakes.wrong: Ich stehe auf um sieben Uhr.
common_mistakes.correct: Ich stehe um sieben Uhr auf.
common_mistakes.explanation: In a neutral main clause, put the separable prefix at the end after the time phrase.
Dann is first, so the conjugated verb comes next.

mastery_goal: You can describe your typical day in the present tense using time expressions and correct word order.
